latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — premium white-collar resume builder with PDF rendering.

- Build, rewrite, or tailor resumes from real candidate information for white-collar roles.
- Generate structured resume drafts, Typst source files, and polished PDF resumes.
- Adheres to business-focused writing and premium executive visual standards.
- Factual only: does not invent experience or unsupported claims.
- Output workflow ensures task is only complete if PDF render succeeds.
